mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_audit_log (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, before_json, after_json, ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{actionType}, #{entityName}, #{entityId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{ip})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.audit_id, a.user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, a.action_type, a.entity_name, a.entity_id, a.before_json, a.after_json, a.ip, a.action_at FROM gw_audit_log a LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
ORDER BY a.action_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_audit_log a LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
SELECT DISTINCT action_type FROM gw_audit_log ORDER BY action_type
SELECT DISTINCT entity_name FROM gw_audit_log WHERE entity_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entity_name
